query: SELECT run_id,sla_metric,bound_ms,achieved_p99_ms,achieved_p99_ms/bound_ms AS ratio,is_violation FROM v_infraction WHERE is_current AND run_id IN ('sweeps:llm_burst1_aic_s1','sweeps:llm_burst1_poly_s1','sweeps:vision_burst1_s1'); SELECT grid_run_id,window_name,tp,llm_workers,ttft_p99_ms FROM grid_llm_point WHERE window_name ILIKE '%burst%' AND tp=1 ORDER BY llm_workers,ttft_p99_ms;
